geometry_reconstruction.rule: regular n-gon from n/R/phase_deg/centre via verified regular_polygon_vertices; outer square [-1,1]^2; original double coordinates, no phase guessing

sobol.definition: qmc.Sobol(d=2, scramble=True, seed=20261022+gid), 2^16 candidates, filter to fluid region, take first 4340 accepted in Sobol order

jittered.definition: 90x90 cell centers on [-1,1]^2, uniform +/-0.4 cell (JITTER_FRACTION=0.8 of full cell width; half-width 0.4*cell) jitter per axis, filter to fluid region, fixed-rng shuffle, take first 4340

wall_sampling.outer: square perimeter 8, 492 points at (i+0.5)*8/492, CCW from (-1,-1)
wall_sampling.inner: polygon perimeter, 168 points at (i+0.5)*P/168, CCW from first vertex
wall_sampling.perimeter_rule: equal arc length with half-step offset

reference.interpolation: k=8 inverse-distance squared IDW from the same geometry's published fields; exact coincidence returns the original label; pressure has no offset
reference.walls: u=v=0; T=0 on outer wall, T=1 on inner wall (known BC); p remains IDW
reference.label_source: per-channel fixed-width Unicode [N,4] (u,v,p,T): wall u/v/T are always wall_bc even at exact coincidence; p is always idw/exact_original; interior channels are idw/exact_original
reference.terminology: interpolated reference (not FEM re-mesh, not new truth)

holdout_diagnostic.source: all 660 wall nodes + remaining 3472 interior nodes
holdout_diagnostic.note: not a strict upper bound for new-point label error and not independent numerical validation; k not tuned

metrics.normalization: training-only stats saved in each seed's metrics
metrics.forward: single full-5000 symmetric context per distribution; no chunking
metrics.all5000: RE/MAE/max per field over 5000 new points
metrics.wall: RE/MAE/max per field over 660 wall points (zero denominator RE=null)
metrics.statistics_primary: per seed: equal-weight mean over the 20 geometries (valid non-null only, count recorded); across seeds: mean/sample std (ddof=1). This is the main statistic.
metrics.per_geometry_supplement: each geometry's 5-seed mean/std kept as supplement; median of per-geometry seed std is NOT the main seed std
metrics.aggregation: primary per-seed 20-geometry mean -> 5-seed mean/sample std; per_geometry supplement; both distributions separate
metrics.reproduction: original 5000-point RE vs metrics JSON per seed x geom <=1e-6

cuda_or_training: none (CPU analysis only; no weight updates)
